_readme: IFC-SG MEP Auditor checklist. Keys starting with '_' are comments. Any key you delete falls back to the built-in default in script.py. Shift+Click the ribbon button to open this file.
_audit_categories: Report label -> Revit BuiltInCategory name. Add e.g. "Duct Fittings": "OST_DuctFitting" to audit more categories.
_required_parameters: '*' applies to every category; other keys (matching the labels above) add category-specific parameters. Names are matched as shown in the Revit Properties palette (instance first, then type).
_check_type_parameters: If the instance value is blank, accept a value on the element's type (e.g. Fire_Rating stored as a type parameter).
_flag_parameters_not_found: Report parameters that are not loaded/bound to the category at all, as '<name> [not found]'.

clash_check._bbox_inset_mm: Shrinks each structural bounding box on every side so MEP that only touches the structure is not flagged.

qa_view.name: QA_MEP_Compliance_Check
qa_view._passing_transparency: 0-100. Makes passing elements see-through so failures stand out.

report._output_folder: Leave empty to save to the Desktop. Environment variables are allowed, e.g. %USERPROFILE%\Documents\BIM_QA
